material_findings.title: OATS provides a public action-scoped authority and receipt model for autonomous agents
material_findings.summary: The Sep. 14 cs.CR batch includes arXiv:2609.12001, which argues that clean registry scans do not answer whether an agent action is permitted for a specific operator. Its public OATS repository defines portable authority policies, action receipts, lifecycle attestations and evidence-backed autonomy transitions. GitHub independently confirms the public artifact and Apache-2.0 license. The paper's measurements and the implementation's behavior have not been independently reproduced by this repository.
material_findings.recommended_action: When chronological research integration reaches this contribution, preserve the exact repository commit used for evaluation, run the dependency-free validator/reference-runtime tests in an isolated benign environment, exercise action-policy/receipt/demotion behavior against local fixtures, and compare the model with the suite's existing authorization and provenance contracts before proposing any integration.
